title: How Google Pay, Paytm, PhonePe Makes Money | How They Earn Money | How Google Pay Gives Cashback
description: How Google Pay, PhonePe and Paytm makes money. Google Pay is already giving Cash backs with free service enabling it's users to do any kind of Money Transaction, Bill Payment and also Fund Transfer.  Google Pay is owned by Google and definitely PhonePe is owned by Flipkart, of which Walmart has majority ownership. Both are funded by Top American Tech Giants.  Google Pay doesn't additionally charge users, merchants, and developers additional fees to use the Google Pay API for payments. Merchants, specifically, continue to pay processing fees to their payment processor.  All of the UPI ( Unified Payment Interface) based apps are providing the money transfer or bill payment absolutely because of NPCI - National Payments Corporation of India.  Under RBI (Reserve Bank of India ), NPCI gives the permission to use the UPI absolutely free of cost and this facility is being used by all payment apps like Google Pay, Paytm or Phone Pay or even BHIM UPI.  All cards added to Google go through a verification authorization to validate card details, which include the card verification code (CVC). Google also runs a proprietary risk engine based on instrument data, Google account profiles, purchase history, locations, and device information. Merchants, however, must continue to use their current fraud and risk assessment tools with Google Pay transactions.
